title: Hugging Face trains harness adapters live in the open for Inkling-2-Mini and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, with checkpoints and GGUFs public
headline: Hugging Face trains open harness adapters live with GGUFs
lede: Builders can follow a live dashboard and pull weights, training data, experiment logs, and intermediate GGUFs as Hugging Face trains harness adapters for Inkling-2-Mini and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.

effects.effect: Makes harness-specific model adaptation an open, inspectable training workflow.
Publishes intermediate GGUFs so local runners can test adapted models mid-run.
Demonstrates tailoring compact models to specific agent harnesses rather than generic prompts.

appearances.newly_possible: Builders can follow a live dashboard and pull weights, training data, experiment logs, and intermediate GGUFs as Hugging Face trains harness adapters for Inkling-2-Mini and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.
appearances.why: Openly adapting compact local models to specific agent harnesses like Pi, Hermes, and DeepSeek-Harness provides a repeatable recipe for better tool use.
appearances.limits: The training run is still in progress and no final benchmark gains are reported yet.
